column5: - **Projection grammar encoded twice**: content.rs:526-582 and 439-482 (same tag bytes); algebra tags at 513-524 and inline at 484-493 (reader: suspected). A third site with tags 3/2 is semantic-vocabulary/src/storage.rs:366-367.

- **Per-machine lookup**: flow-effects lib.rs:182, 516 (linear scans) and 249 (cached index). In proof_applications.rs the machine/target lookup is written twice (73-116 scan; 252-297 sorted index) and the family binder rebasing loop twice (457-470, 585-605).
- **Interning by linear scan, id = index + 1**: language-semantics lib.rs:1221, 1821, 2091, 2164.
- **Identity-else-name member key**: layout_reports.rs:406, 505, 367-404; materialization.rs:592, 723, 750; also access_fields.rs:251-254.
- **Bit-range validity**: materialization.rs:1052, 1351; symbolic_materialization.rs:914. **Array stride checks**: materialization.rs:254-267 (decode) and 1787-1816 (encode).

- **Float operation name lists**: `FLOAT_OPERATIONS` (numeric_intrinsics.rs:144-288, 29 rows), `FLOAT_SEMANTIC_OPERATIONS` and `FLOAT_NAMED_CALL_LEAVES` (float_semantics.rs:1262-1366), `FloatProjectionOperation` (numerics/src/lib.rs:996). The first two are tied by an arity-only test (numeric_intrinsics.rs:606-648). In the checked interpreter the named float operations are mapped again in CI/execution_expressions.rs:1023-1277 (30-arm match) and CI/execution_scalars.rs:1037-1193 (tables), and float classification is written at CI/execution_expressions.rs:801-850 and 1157-1184.

- **Trapping/saturating float policy application**: float_semantics.rs:486-506 is the definition; call sites repeat the surrounding logic at CI/execution_expressions.rs:1103-1127, CI/execution_scalars.rs:1179-1193, 1522-1568; TI/engine_execution.rs:3308 and step 05 published_facts_crash_calls.rs:4371-4381 (unit 108: grepped, not read).

- **Integer policy described three times**: `IntegerType` methods (proposition.rs:662-1024), `ArithmeticDomain` + `integer_policy_bridge` (numerics lib.rs:44, 392), `LandedIntegerType::bounds` (literals.rs:42). In the checked interpreter wrap/clamp/trap by domain is written three more times (CI/interpreter.rs:349-367; CI/execution_scalars.rs:1299-1448, 183-211). `fn integer_bounds` exists in five other files (unit 110: grepped, suspected).
